changelog:
Initial public release: major upgrade to unified knowledge capture and retrieval.

- Centralizes all forms of knowledge (URLs, extracts, social posts, agent research) in a file-based system.
- New command-line tool (`know`) for adding, searching, tidying, and managing knowledge entries.
- Structured markdown with YAML frontmatter ensures interoperable and searchable data.
- Supports tagging, summarizing, and categorizing all items; maintains an auto-generated index.
- Integrated with QMD for rich search and collection management.
- Local config, extensible storage paths, and recommended maintenance routines.
